description: This file defines a mock class 'MockIInterfaceDetailsIterator' for unit testing purposes. It inherits from an interface within the WPEFramework network management namespace and uses Google's gMock framework to create mock methods for iterator operations such as Next, Previous, Reset, etc.

classes.name: MockIInterfaceDetailsIterator
classes.description: A mock class for INetworkManager::IInterfaceDetailsIterator to facilitate unit testing of network interface iteration logic.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Mocks the method to move to the next network interface detail.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Mocks the method to move to the previous network interface detail.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Mocks resetting the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Mocks checking if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the total count of interface details.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current interface details.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks querying for a specific interface.
